anomalies.description: Multiple players from opposing teams (Philadelphia Flyers in white/orange and Pittsburgh Penguins in black/gold) engage in a sustained, multi-person physical altercation near the boards, involving grappling, shoving, and helmeted players wrestling while referees intervene to separate them.

Two ice hockey players engage in a sustained mutual fistfight along the boards, exchanging punches while grappling; one player wears a white Philadelphia Flyers jersey (No. 17), the other a black Pittsburgh Penguins jersey (No. 10, 'GLASS').

Two ice hockey players—one in a white/orange Philadelphia Flyers jersey (No. 17) and one in a black/gold Pittsburgh Penguins jersey (No. 10)—engage in a sustained, mutual physical fight along the boards. They grapple, clinch, and exchange punches repeatedly over multiple seconds, with neither player appearing passive or helpless; the referee (No. 93) is present but does not immediately intervene.

Player #17 (Flyers) appears to be held or pinned by multiple opponents while being struck or pushed into the boards; referee #93 intervenes directly at 123.0–123.5, suggesting the player was temporarily helpless during that interval.
